article.headline: Jalen Duren's $200M Extension Changes Everything for Detroit's Championship Hopes

research.facts:
Jalen Duren Extension — Detroit Pistons
**Sources searched:** AP/KSL.com, La Nacion (AP wire), Rotoballer, AJC, Eurohoops, BlackAmericaWeb
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Duren agreed to a five-year, $200 million fully guaranteed extension with the Detroit Pistons [AP source confirmed by Rotoballer, AJC, La Nacion/AP]
- Deal reached hours before the restricted free agency deadline [AP source]
- Agent Chafie Fields confirmed the agreement to ESPN senior NBA insider Shams Charania [Eurohoops/AP reports]
- Pistons completely removed conditioning/weight clauses from the proposal — that was the sticking point all summer [Eurohoops, BlackAmericaWeb context]
- Duren stats in 2025-26: 18.0 points per game, 10.2 rebounds per game [Rotoballer]
- Duren earned All-Star honors and Third Team All-NBA selection in 2025-26 [Rotoballer]
- Detroit went 60-22 in the regular season 2025-26 [Rotoballer context; also matches pipeline history]
- Duren is age 22 (from pipeline story history 2026-09-27: "age 22")
**NOTE — Discrepancy on stats:**
- Story history (Sept 27-28 pipeline) had Duren at 19.5 pts, 10.5 reb
- New search (AP/Rotoballer) says 18.0 pts, 10.2 reb
- Likely: 19.5/10.5 was a projection or early-season pace; 18.0/10.2 is final 2025-26 season average
- **Using 18.0 pts, 10.2 reb** (from verified AP-sourced report) — tag as MEDIUM due to single new-search source; flag for fact-check
**Facts to avoid (LOW confidence):**
- Exact contract start/end years not confirmed — avoid using
- Signing bonus breakdown — not confirmed
